script: Digital work attracts scammers who target people who are new and eager. The good news is that the warning signs are clear. Learn them, and you will avoid most problems. If you are asked to pay a fee to get a job, join a team, or unlock a payment, it is a scam. Real employers do not charge you to start work. If you are offered very high pay for very easy work, with a quick start bonus, that is also a scam. If a client sends you a cheque and asks you to return part of it, that is fraud. The original payment will bounce later. Other signs include a client who wants to move the chat off the platform straight away. They want to avoid the platform's protection, so be careful. Anyone who asks for your OTP, your PIN, your password, or a code sent to your phone is a scammer. Real staff never ask. Be wary of any request to download an unknown app, or to open a file to verify work.
